query: SELECT a.*, d.details_json, d.scraped_at FROM aoc_tenders a LEFT JOIN aoc_details d USING(internal_id) WHERE a.tender_id = ? OR a.ref_no = ?
limitations: Exact public tender ID/reference lookup only; zero records is not proof no award exists.
Listing closing_date has audited publication semantics and is not used for evaluation speed.
Contractor text not merged to corporate identity.
